ultimate_doctor_strange.title: SORCERER SUPREME
ultimate_doctor_strange.text: Wielding an unmatched arsenal of mystic arts, Doctor Strange bent space, time, and reality itself to completely unravel the villain's grand design.

deck.name: Orb of Agamotto
deck.effect_text: As long as this card is faceup in the Storyline, the top card of the Master Plan deck is revealed.
